summary: childhood friend has moved to The Next Place Not friend a mirror of Faults in accomplishments Someone who share lives Milestones or more usually silently commiserated in their absence Acting as dreams were never gone #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
childhood
friend
has moved to
The Next Place
Not friend
a mirror of
Faults in accomplishments
Someone who share lives
Milestones
or more usually silently
commiserated in their absence
Acting as dreams were never gone
#smallpoems
